Right-biased U.S. news outlets tend to emphasize risks related to the false portrayal of historical figures and biases in content moderation systems, often using politicized language that aligns with their agenda on freedom of expression and perceived cultural conflicts. They report on issues such as AI systems like ChatGPT producing responses that are skewed against conservatives and the flagging of negative comments about women as hateful compared to similar comments about men.

In contrast, left-biased outlets focus on the inclusion of far-right and non-reputable sources in AI training data, which they argue leads to the dissemination of hate speech. They also report on the negative impacts of AI technologies on marginalized groups, such as financial discrimination against people of color and wrongful arrests due to AI facial recognition tools. The language used by left-biased outlets tends to highlight systemic discrimination and the harmful effects of AI on vulnerable populations.
